def spark(xs, threshold):
    line = ''
    for v in xs:
        if v > threshold:
            line = line + '#'
        else:
            line = line + '.'
    return line

def draw_box(lo, med, hi, lo_f, hi_f, xs):
    line = ''
    for v in range(0, 25):
        if v == lo or v == med or v == hi:
            line = line + '|'
        elif lo < v < hi:
            line = line + '='
        elif v == round(hi_f) or v == round(lo_f):
            line = line + '!'
        else:
            line = line + '.'
    print(line)
